caption: What should you do against high cortisol? #usahealth #wellness #healthybodyhealthymind #wellnessjourney #healthy
transcript: That ringing in your ears comes from cortisol and nobody told you. Fatigue, poor sleep, brain fog, sugar cravings, all signs that has been high for too long. Bringing it down requires healthy blood flow. With age, your body makes less nitric oxide, the compound that keeps your vessels open. Circulation slows, they tighten, and the smallest ones feeding your ears suffer first. A vicious cycle, my friend. Stress slows the blood, and slow blood keeps the stress alive. Beetroot breaks it. Its nitrates rebuild nitric oxide, the vessels open again, and cortisol finally falls. Those who try it say the ringing eases, sleep returns, the mind clears. Begin your journey back to calm today, my friend. With my book, The Way Back to Stillness. You can find it in my profile.
